name: DDD Hexagonal Architecture Pattern
description: Domain-Driven Design with hexagonal (ports-and-adapters) layering. Domain is pure; Application owns ports; Adapters implement ports; Presentation depends on Application.

nodes.name: Domain Layer
nodes.description: Pure domain logic: entities, value objects, domain events, command types. Zero external imports. No IO, no DOM, no global state.

nodes.name: Application Layer
nodes.description: CQRS command handlers (write side) and queries (read side). Declares ports as interfaces. Imports Domain only. Never imports adapters.

nodes.name: Ports (Interfaces)
nodes.description: Declared in Application layer. Abstractions over persistence, serialisation, external communication. Adapters implement these; Application depends on them.

nodes.name: Adapters Layer
nodes.description: Concrete implementations of Ports: storage adapters, serialisers, validators, host bridges. Depend on Application + Ports. Injected at boot (dependency inversion).

nodes.name: Presentation Layer
nodes.description: UI components, runners, harnesses. Renders Application state, dispatches commands. Imports Application only. No domain logic.

relationships.description: Presentation dispatches commands to Application and subscribes to Application state
Application command handlers validate against Domain types and emit Domain events
Application owns port interfaces; it depends on abstractions it declares
Adapters implement port interfaces and are injected at boot time
